Quiz: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane Story Quiz
Question: How did Jesus pray about the cup?
OptionA: Let this cup pass from Me, nevertheless not as I will, but as Thou wilt
OptionB: Take this cup from all men
OptionC: Let the cup be poured out now
OptionD: Give Me strength to avoid it
Explanation: He fell on His face and prayed, O My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from Me: nevertheless not as I will, but as Thou wilt.
